notes.title: Patch "Synergy" 1.3.0 is Out!
notes.content:
Saturday patch 1.3.0 is Live!

[h3]Quality of Life 🌱[/h3]

- Improved effects descriptions.

The following effects explanations and name have been reworked:

- [b]Rally[/b]: when a cat is summoned 
- [b]Water Rally[/b]: when a water cat is summoned 
- [b]Summon[/b]: when you summon the actual card.

[i]Dev notes: noticed there where a few cards that had Rally on their effects but didnt match what how they trigger so I created the Summon effect. [/i]

[h3]Balance ⚖️[/h3]


- [b]Charge[/b]: occurs when an [strike]electric [/strike] ally cat dies. 

[i]Dev notes: For the synergy update it will give more freeway to mix electric cards with other types[/i]

- [b]Banner[/b]: Effects now all cards regardless of their type.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 is Out!
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.0 is Live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/587a56ce2876f7e10777166fec2476ad83bd6ec6.png[/img]

[h3]Quality of Life 🌱[/h3]

[list]
[*] We've improved card handling and animations! Now, moving and dragging cards with the mouse feels much smoother and more intuitive. This was a major pain point for many of you, so we dedicated two weeks to revamp the UI system. The effort has paid off, and it feels fantastic!
[/list]

Looking ahead, I have two major tasks to tackle next:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/587a56ce2876f7e10777166fec2476ad83bd6ec6.png[/img]

First, I'll focus on creating more card synergies, especially freeing up the exclusive effects of the electric and water cards to enable some nastier combos. After that, I'll work on increasing the game's difficulty to provide more challenging runs for those of you looking for a tougher experience!

If you encounter any issues, please let me know on our Discord server! I'm prioritizing the most critical bugs since I'm handling this solo.

Regards,
Johan Croix

notes.title: Weekly Patch 1.1.2 is Live!
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.2 is Live


[h3]Quality of Life 🌱[/h3]

[list]
[*] Huge rework to the battle system and turn manager to ensure better game stability and remove crashes during battle
[*] When you examine a token card it will show its actual effect instead of a generic summon explanation
[*] when you return to the menu during a boss scene it leaves a banner description now the banner hides if you decide to leave
[*] Sometimes when playing against the boss the label battle start pops off before spawning the boss remaning cards so now it waits for all cards to be placed and then the battle actually starts
[/list]


[h3]Balance ⚖️[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/a28e951d589e3fb2c81cb3995f073711f3ca4a6b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/9ef6058665162c6f63f708d49ac8abc4fb3afdc8.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Water cats buffs are lost between fights, you can not longer have a 2000/2000 water cat
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes 🪲[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that the sacrifice trophy will not pop up unless is your first playthough when you opened the game.
[*] Monochrome chains: fixed a bug where this trinket doesnt give buffs to the cards
[*] Goopy Duplicate: Now actually summons a token copy of your first sacrifice.
[*] Spikes damages multipliers are correctly calculated.
[/list]

If you encounter any issues, let me know on our Discord server! I'm prioritizing the toughest bugs since I am the only one on it!

Regards,
Johan Croix

notes.title: Saturday Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Saturday patch 1.0.4 is Live

[h3]Quality of Life 🌱[/h3]

- Improved the feedback form; it was previously hiding the mouse cursor.
- Now the version label is fixed to the corner to pinpoint which version is having issues.

[h3]Balance ⚖️[/h3]

- Adjusted the XP curve so you can have a chance unlocking the Achievement that requires you to upgrade a level 6 card.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/23eec0ef70677262ab4056d1a081c1c6f88f488a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/68579624a25487d41badbee7e98eb0a04172a8ee.png[/img][/url]
- Rock necklace rework: now gives 1 hp to all earth cats each round.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/a28e951d589e3fb2c81cb3995f073711f3ca4a6b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/9ef6058665162c6f63f708d49ac8abc4fb3afdc8.png[/img][/url]
- Upgraded Current cat was giving temporal buffs, it should be permanent for water cats.

[h3]Bug Fixes 🪲[/h3]

- When a player chooses to level up in a "?" encounter, it now actually levels up.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/79673ca59ab4566545e0ea03205d139cfcb2851f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/736927e054a9b777f7f3c9917893dd6ce0246853.png[/img][/url]

- Cards changing size/scale after fights, some cards get squashed, so this fix will prevent that.

If you encounter any issues, let me know on our Discord server! Prioritizing the toughest bugs since I am the only one on it!

Regards,
Johan Croix

notes.title: Something big is comming...

[h1]Attention, Spellcasters![/h1]

We're thrilled to announce  a robust upcoming update addressing your invaluable feedback. Here's what's new:

Gameplay Enhancements:

Introducing Random Encounters on the map, now symbolized by "❓", to keep every adventure fresh and unpredictable.

Card Evolution Unveiled: Collect three copies of a card, and witness them merge into a superior version ⭐ ⭐ ⭐.


Card System Overhaul:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/a4c44b505e64fd3aea5f089ae8f4894ff46c50d1.png[/img]


Revamped Ice & Ground mechanics for a more strategic play.
Numerous card balances to ensure a fair and not much broken op gameplay
Card tiers have been streamlined. For this next release, expect tiers ranging from 1 to 3.



[b]New art from a another pixel artist named Hugo[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/01c7c79a7354cfca8249adef6732d016512734e9.png[/img]

Trinket Tweaks

Given the magnitude of this patch, we'll be double-checking every nook and cranny to ensure a seamless experience for you.

 Once we're satisfied with this update's polish, brace yourselves for the upcoming [b]PROLOGUE[/b] version!

With magic and gratitude,
Johan,
Nintai Studios

notes.title: Demo Update July Part II
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings summoners![/h1]

Demo version 0.6.5 is Live! 

We are excited to announce that Demo version 0.6.5 is now live, bringing you a more stable and polished Spellcats experience! Thank you for your valuable feedback and support during our physical booth event, where we encountered and successfully squashed numerous bugs. As we worked tirelessly through the nights, we managed to eliminate approximately 8 pesky bugs, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience for all of you.

Patch Highlights:

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue preventing players from starting a second game after losing or defeating the boss.
[*] Enhanced overall stability for a more enjoyable playthrough
[/list].

Thank you for your continued enthusiasm for Spellcats! Your feedback is essential in helping us shape the game into an even more magical adventure!

Sincerely,
Nintai Studios

[h2]Cards[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/f22e8aa8626757b3b605ccfa6eb157dec8472245.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/60f0df610ba06d801fa71bc4167a51bbf3730b49.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Flamepurr:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that enemies Flamepurr gives you mana reduction.

[/list]

Developer notes: Flamepurr was filled with bugs so i had to take it to the vet

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/6515765ea6bbd6a04fb5260b6617dcfd813dc1e5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/ab517c06ed67163040c01d29747404f96a9ffa9c.png[/img][/url]
[h3]NekoBurst[/h3]
Effect [strike]Die: give fire nekos 2 Atk [/strike] -> New effect: Die :deal 3 damage to target enemy

Effect [strike]Allied died: gain +3 Atk  [/strike] -> Die: give random ally shield

[list]

[list]
[*] Battle: added a visual indicator when there are more cards outside the screen.
[*] Store: when you get exceeding mana you'll get a visual indicator on how much mana you have

notes.title: Summon Kitties early with the Spellcats demo
notes.content:
Hi guys we recently shadowdropped the demo. and now with some quick fixes we are proud to announce it officially!


i will let you know some features i've got working and thanks to player feedback got added to the demo

[list]
[*] 5 elements [b]30 cards[/b] (6 cards per element) from tier 1 to tier 3 
[*] [b]map events[/b]: resting and chest event
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b] every time you start a new run your past life will remind you how to play
[*] [b]trinket[/b] system ( i thought it wouldnt make it to the demo but here it is): objects that can make your cat army even more powerfull. Just like enchantments in mtg or relics in slay the spire!
[/list]

Keep in mind during development i will update the demo to check your opinions and suggestions.


Hope you enjoy it and soon i will post a discord server so we all can talk about spellcats ːcozybethesdaː
